title: Zhevra
wikitext:
[[image:Zhevra.png|thumb|Swiftmane]]
A species of [[unicorn]]. It is a horse-like beast common to the [[Barrens]]. They are neutral, but will defend themselves with kicks if attacked. Their name is similar to the real-life species, the zebra.

Notable zhevra:
* [[Swiftmane]], a legendary zhevra which can run at incredible speeds.

Types of zhevra:
* [[Zhevra Charger]]
* [[Zhevra Courser]]
* [[Zhevra Runner]]
